headlines.headline: SECOND HIDDEN CLIPPERS-KAWHI ENDORSEMENT DEAL SURFACES, LEAVING RAPTORS TRADE IN LIMBO
headlines.detail: New reporting alleges Kawhi Leonard held an undisclosed sponsorship with Daktronics, the company that built the Clippers' Intuit Dome scoreboard, adding to the league's existing probe into his $28M deal with the now-bankrupt Aspiration. The Raptors-Clippers trade remains on hold.

headlines.headline: COMMANDERS LT LAREMY TUNSIL TEARS TRICEPS, WILL MISS MOST OF 2026 SEASON
headlines.detail: Tunsil suffered the injury Saturday fighting off a bull rush from free-agent addition Odafe Oweh, just five months after Washington made him the NFL's highest-paid offensive lineman on a two-year, $60.2M extension. Brandon Coleman replaces him at left tackle.

headlines.headline: ALABAMA'S QB BATTLE TIGHTENS AS RUSSELL OUTDUELS MACK IN FALL CAMP SCRIMMAGE
headlines.detail: Keelon Russell went 20-of-32 for 229 yards and 4 touchdowns against Austin Mack's 7-of-13, 95 yards and 1 touchdown, with Kalen DeBoer hoping to name a starter as early as Aug. 17 to replace NFL-bound Ty Simpson.

headlines.headline: TENNESSEE JUDGE GRANTS TEXAS TRANSFER A FIFTH SEASON, DEEPENING NCAA'S ELIGIBILITY CRISIS
headlines.detail: A Tennessee court ruled Texas transfer Chendall Weaver can play a fifth college season, and he immediately committed to Houston — the latest case pushing administrators toward a blanket eligibility waiver ahead of the 2027 expansion to a 76-team tournament field.
